设计意图： Measures smoothness of daily price action by comparing return magnitude to high-low range. Using rolling median instead of mean reduces sensitivity to extreme daily moves, potentially improving predictive consistency while preserving the stable payoff mechanism of the parent. Low ratio indicates the close is near the midpoint (choppy/smooth), high ratio indicates strong directional movement. Negat

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-ts_median(20, (close/ts_delay(close)-1)^2 / (high-low)^2)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(divide(power(subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1), 2), power(subtract(high, low), 2)), 20)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(power(subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1), 2), power(subtract(high, low), 2))
  3. 3. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1), 2)
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(close, ts_delay(close))
  6. 6. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(close)
  7. 7. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(subtract(high, low), 2)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(high, low)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
ts_mediann 期滚动中位数

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 daily_ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1
  2. 计算 daily_range：high - low
  3. 计算 smoothness_ratio：(daily_ret ** 2) / (daily_range ** 2)
  4. 计算 median_ratio：smoothness_ratio.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).median()
  5. 计算 factor：-median_ratio
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_smoothness_median(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Daily "kw">class="kw">return magnitude relative to intraday range daily_ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(1) - 1 daily_range = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] "com"># Ratio of squared "kw">class="kw">return to squared range; small when price moves smoothly within range smoothness_ratio = (daily_ret ** 2) / (daily_range ** 2).replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Rolling median of smoothness ratio over 20 days reduces outlier impact median_ratio = smoothness_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=10).median() "com"># Negative so high factor = smooth factor = -median_ratio df_copy["factor_price_smoothness_median"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_price_smoothness_median"]
